limitations: Trusted authored fixture worker doubles are not native Docker containment/recovery qualification or authentic repository outcomes.
Checksums are local integrity anchors, not authenticated state against a host attacker replacing all sources and evidence anchors.
The frozen codec alone cannot authenticate rehashed numerical cache values; mission public replay now compares them.
Accepted-only crossmission sampling is biased and does not establish causal computation benefit or transfer.
Mission decision batch caps differ from the unlimited-stream schedule; the heldout mechanism result does not establish coding performance.
Whole-mission CPU and strict aggregate peak memory remain unqualified; named stage costs omit work outside their timers.
The temporal mechanism experiment failed its combined primary gate. Optional wiring is not a promotion or a self-improvement claim.
